description: USFS replaced its 9 regional offices with 15 state directors, many overseeing several states. Staff describe regional reporting chains as upended. The role now combines line authority with state-partnership brokering.

role_title: State forestry staff delivering federal land work under Good Neighbor Authority
description: States are being asked to help manage federal land as USFS capacity shrinks (about 16% of staff lost). State foresters report key vacancies and unclear expectations, which raises demand for federal process knowledge in state roles.

role_title: DOI bureau wildland fire positions (BIA, BLM, NPS, FWS, OAS, OWF) consolidated into USWFS
description: Fire programs from six DOI units were consolidated into the U.S. Wildland Fire Service (Jan 2026). Aligned USWFS/USFS qualification standards take effect Jan 2027, and some positions will be archived.

role_title: Fish and Wildlife Administration (0480), Zoology (0410), Horticulture (0437), Animal Science (0487) realigned to 0401
description: OPM Phase One consolidation realigns these low-employment series into General Natural Resources Management and Biological Science (0401). Grade and pay are unchanged, but duties must be described within 0401.

role_title: Range Technician (0455) to 0404; Outdoor Recreation Planning (0023) to 0186
description: OPM Phase One realigns 0455 (147 employees) into Biological Science Technician (0404) and 0023 (368) into 0186. Range-specific competencies risk losing visibility in a broader series.

role_title: Environmental Protection Assistant (0029) to 0303; Environmental Health Technician (0698) to 0640
description: OPM Phase One realigns these into general assistant and health technician series, removing environment-specific series identity at the support level.

role_title: Agency strategic hiring committee members and talent teams
description: EO 14356 (Oct 2025) requires strategic hiring committees to approve every vacancy and annual staffing plans aimed at critical skills gaps. The Merit Hiring Plan requires agency talent teams. These are new decision points where skills-gap evidence is used.

role_title: Agency job-analysis and technical-assessment specialist (serving natural-resource series)
description: Chance to Compete requires job-analysis-based technical assessments, with Natural Resources Management a Tier 2 group. OPM notes agencies may need training to run local job analyses. Demand rises for HR staff who can run SME-based job analysis for environmental series.

The 2025 hiring freeze and 1-for-4 replacement order, a 12% fall in the federal civilian workforce (Sep 2024 to Jan 2026) and USFS losses narrow federal entry. This compounds v1's career-ladder-destruction concern.

role_title: Conservation corps members funded through AmeriCorps
description: Mass grant terminations in spring 2025 were partly restored by litigation. A Sep 2026 settlement protects FY2026, but the stay ends Feb 1, 2027. Land trusts report placements in jeopardy.

role_title: Forest Service research station scientists and technicians
description: The USFS reorganization keeps 20 research stations open and closes 57, removing a long-standing entry and development path for research technicians and field scientists.

The Corps Network's workforce team now focuses on career pathways, employer partnerships, credentialing, apprenticeships and post-placement outcomes, with a JFF practice framework. Corps staff roles are shifting from crew supervision toward career navigation.
